parameters.name: Keyword
parameters.description: The keyword of the tag name. Fuzzy match is supported. You can enter a keyword to query all tags that contain the keyword.

parameters.name: MaxResult
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: **1** to **100**. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The token for the next query. Valid values:
- If this is the first query or there is no next query, leave this parameter empty.
- If there is a next query, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the resource.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The resource ID. You can specify up to 20 resource IDs.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource type. Valid values:
- **PHYSICALCONNECTION**: Express Connect circuit instance.
- **VIRTUALBORDERROUTER**: Virtual Border Router.
- **ROUTERINTERFACE**: VBR uplink.
- **TRAFFICQOS**: QoS policy.

> This parameter is essentially required. If it is not specified, the service returns MissingParameter (400).
